repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server parses MQTT subscription requests before registering the requested subscriptions.

### Problem Description

The MQTT packet reader did not consistently apply a configured finite size bound after CONNECT. Oversized subscription packets could reach buffering and filter parsing despite max_payload, causing excessive allocations. Subscription-count limits applied later and did not prevent these parsing costs. Resource exhaustion could affect the entire server process.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-8fcg-2fq8-c8qc>
 * Credit: @X1AOxiang
repo.summary: Oversized MQTT subscription packets can exhaust server resources
